text_block_list.text:
I'm walking Хиши Амадзон through the
training
regimen, but something is really
bugging me...

Hm? Oh, just bedhead—or bedtail, I
guess.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
It wasn't completely dry before I went to
sleep
last night. The younger students in
the dorm had
the same reaction as you.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
But yeah... stuff like this happens to the
best of
us. More importantly...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Yawn... Huh, what was I talkin' about again?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон looks like she's about to
fall asleep
any second. She must be
exhausted. It might be
best to adjust her
race schedule.
